caption:
0-1 down at half-time. Champions six minutes later.

India beat China 3-1 in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy final in Bhopal tonight. Chen Yujun put China ahead in the 25th minute. Then India scored three times in the third quarter: Deepika from a penalty corner (38'), Ishika (42') and Deepika from another penalty corner (43').

That is India's third title in a row (2023, 2024, 2026) and a record fourth overall. No team has won this trophy more.

Deepika ends the tournament as top scorer with 12 goals. India also beat China 6-2 in the pool stage earlier this week.
